Sanitary Sewer Rehabilitation
Sanitary Sewer Repairs

Starting Date: Weather permitting, Friday November 6,
2026.
Description of Work Activities: The City of Ames has
contracted with Municipal Pipe Tool, LLC. to perform repairs
to the sanitary sewer system in your area. The purpose of
this work is to repairs aging infrastructure and reduce the risk
of sanitary sewer backups. You may notice utility flags as the
underground utilities are located prior to construction

Starting Friday November 6th, Municipal Pipe Tool and its
subcontractors will begin sanitary sewer point repairs on Ford
Street. Construction activities will include pavement removal
and repairs to the existing sanitary sewer main. This work
will require a localized road closure on Ford Street.
Access to all businesses will be maintained
throughout construction via either Dayton Avenue or
E. Lincoln Way. Further notices will be delivered as
construction proceeds.
Anticipated Duration: The contractor is anticipating 3 to 5
days for this closure.
Action Required by Businesses: No action is required at
this time. Please review the anticipated project limit on back
of this page. This work will not prevent access to your
business. All are encouraged to take note of this
construction activity in the area and allow extra travel time as
delays may occur. As always, caution should be exercise
when traveling through the construction area.
